messages:
Maya: quick question about /v1/embeddings handling of mixed input batches (strings, numbers, empty strings, nulls, booleans). what's the canonical contract? do we coerce non-strings or mark them invalid? cc @Simon @Raj @Tina

Simon: today the runtime coerces numbers & booleans to strings and produces embeddings. empty string -> valid vector. null/undefined are returned as null placeholders in the output array (preserve order).

Raj: note: we preserved placeholders historically to avoid failing whole requests. that prevented full-request errors but caused downstream NPEs for clients assuming vectors everywhere.

Tina: saw a production failure yesterday where a batch with a null entry caused an ETL job to crash inserting into Postgres. we should give callers a stricter opt-in so they can fail-fast. :warning:

Maya: proposal for API contract (for discussion):
- add `strict_items` boolean (default: false). if true, any null/undefined -> 422 with indices.
- add `coerce_non_strings` boolean (default: true). when true we coerce numbers/booleans to strings. when false + strict -> numbers/booleans counted as invalid.
- empty string allowed and embedded.
- keep ordering and 1:1 length only for successful requests (i.e., after validation).

Simon: compatibility note: we can't flip defaults immediately. introduce flags, emit warnings, and run a deprecation cycle before changing default semantics.

Raj: suggested legacy vs strict behaviors:
- strict_items=false (legacy): return 200, `data` array same length, invalid items replaced by null placeholders, add top-level `warnings` array describing indices+codes.
- strict_items=true: return 422 with payload `{ error: "invalid_items", indices: [...], message: "..." }`.

Maya: truncation detail: runtime truncates per-item by UTF-8 byte count (per_item_max_bytes, currently 4096) before tokenization. that can split multibyte emojis. should we expose `truncate` option: `tail|head|none` (default `tail`)?

Tina: +1 on explicit truncate option. also add a unit test with emoji-heavy strings so we don't accidentally cut codepoints mid-sequence.

Simon: implementation ordering we should document: 1) apply byte-based truncate -> 2) coerce types (if enabled) -> 3) tokenize -> 4) embed. add unit tests for emoji truncation and for the coercion matrix.

Maya: example doc snippet to include in docs: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-001",
  "inputs": ["hello", 42, "", null, true, "🔥🔥🔥 long text ..."],
  "strict_items": true,
  "coerce_non_strings": true,
  "truncate": "tail"
}
```
If strict_items=true and null present -> 422 response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
{ "error": "invalid_items", "indices": [3], "message": "items at indices contain null or undefined" }
```
If strict_items=false (compat) -> 200 with `warnings`: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "model": "redwood-embed-001", "data": [ [..], [..], [..], null, [..], [..] ], "warnings": [ {"code":"null_item","indices":[3],"message":"null items returned as null placeholders"} ] }
```
Notes: vectors for a model alias must be fixed-length (e.g., 1536 floats for this alias) and remain stable across patch releases. `coerce_non_strings=false` + strict=false -> still return 200 but include a warning that non-strings were present and not coerced.

Raj: action items:
- eng-ml: add contract tests for strict_items=true failure mode and strict_items=false legacy mode with warnings. I'll open a PR. @Raj
- eng-platform: update public API docs + changelog for byte-based truncation, expose `truncate` option and document emoji caveat. @Simon
- eng-oncall: add an alert to surface top clients receiving null vectors so we can reach out. @Tina

Simon: I'll draft the migration spec and include a 90-day deprecation plan. add unit tests for the coercion matrix and emoji truncation.

Maya: timeline: docs + spec PR by EOD Thursday; contract tests PR by next Tuesday. I'll file PRs and tag reviewers, will post links here.

deploy-bot: embeddings-service v1.14.2 deployed to staging :rocket:

Tina: thanks 94 I'll start the oncall alert config after docs merge. :+1:

Simon: spec issue #4687 updated. ping here when PRs are up.

Maya: will follow up with PR links and CL numbers. thanks everyone!
